name: TikTok OAuth creates a secure NTWRKH creator workspace
covers: OAuth state expiry and replay protection
description: Verifies a TikTok identity can create and restore a secure NTWRKH account.
steps: Complete authorization using the configured TikTok developer app
expected: The creator workspace is restored and only profile metadata and granted scopes are visible; tokens remain server-side.

name: TikTok Creator Lab generates a seven-day strategy
covers: TikTok search phrase and hashtag themes
honest disclosure of unavailable live trend data
description: Verifies a creator brief produces a practical TikTok strategy without claiming live trend access.
steps: Enter a niche and optional audience, goal, format and region
expected: The result shows positioning, pillars, hooks, seven calendar entries, search phrases, hashtag themes and engagement prompts.

name: Discover YouTube videos and creators with public API data
covers: search validation and quota error handling
existing NTWRKH Discover feed remains separate
description: Verifies YouTube search returns public video or channel results and useful public statistics without exposing the API key.
steps: Search for a niche or keyword in Videos
Review video thumbnails, channel names and view counts
Switch to Creators & channels and search again
expected: Relevant public videos or channels appear with available public statistics, links open YouTube, and the original Discover feed remains available separately.

name: Submit content, understand it and generate distribution opportunities
covers: AI content classification and audience understanding
description: Verifies the primary agent-first workflow analyses submitted content and returns actionable distribution opportunities while preserving the existing discovery feed.
steps: Paste a caption and optionally upload an image in the content intake area
Review the detected category, topic, audience and keywords
expected: The submitted content is analysed, its topic and likely audience are displayed, and the distribution endpoint returns recommendations without requiring a separate dashboard workflow.

name: Protect creator data and validate YouTube discovery on mobile
description: Verifies private routes reject anonymous access, invalid YouTube searches are blocked, and the new discovery interface works on mobile.
steps: Open a private workspace API without a TikTok session
Sign in and open YouTube Discover on mobile
Verify validation feedback and enter a two-character keyword
Open TikTok Creator Lab and Create content
expected: Private data is not exposed, short searches are blocked with feedback, and YouTube discovery remains usable on a mobile screen.
